Only issued invoices can be written off.

## Notes from earlier work
Memory items from past tasks:
- [rb-0312] Reuse existing money/audit helpers instead of ad-hoc arithmetic: Implement refunds with the repo's round_money/to_money/ZERO, ensure_utc, BillingError and audit.record rather than floats or plain round().
  Normalize amounts with round_money(to_money(amount)), compare against captured with Decimal-safe helpers, and write an audit.record('payment_refunded', ...) entry including amount, refunded_amount, at, idempotency_key and approved_by.
- [rb-0318] Record idempotency_key in the audit entry you write: The audit entry must carry the idempotency_key so future replays can find it.
  When writing the audit.record(...) call for the operation, include idempotency_key=idempotency_key alongside the other fields (payment_id, amount, at). Without it, the key lookup on subsequent calls will never match.
- [rb-0301] Reuse existing money helpers for Decimal math: When implementing monetary calculations, reuse the module's existing to_money/round_money/ZERO helpers instead of raw Decimal arithmetic.
  Inspect money.py and sibling functions (e.g. line_total, invoice_total) first; mirror their pattern of to_money() on inputs, sum with ZERO as start value, and round_money() on the result. This keeps rounding and type consistency with the rest of the codebase.
- [rb-0309] Verify edge cases with a quick script, not just tests: Passing visible tests doesn't guarantee correctness; probe boundaries manually.
  After implementing, run a small script over boundary inputs (before start, exactly at start, exactly on a renewal, far future) to catch off-by-one and overflow issues that the provided tests may not cover.
- [rb-0302] Guard division with a falsy total check: For weighted-average style functions, compute the denominator first and return the zero constant when it is falsy to avoid ZeroDivisionError.
  Compute total_quantity = sum(...) and check `if not total_quantity: return ZERO` before dividing. This handles empty line lists and zero-quantity lines uniformly, matching the spec's 'no lines means zero' requirement.
- [rb-0311] Add optional keyword-only policy params to money operations: Team conventions require idempotency_key=None and approved_by=None as keyword-only args so existing callers keep working.
  Signature pattern: def refund(payment, amount, at, *, idempotency_key=None, approved_by=None). Enforce approval thresholds (e.g. >500.00 raises BillingError('approval_required') when approved_by is missing) and record both params in the audit entry.
